# E0216: a minor version narrows a list's length

A list's length is part of what a schema accepts. A minor version that fixes or
shortens a list's length rejects the predecessor's longer and shorter lists.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				l: [...int]
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				l: [int, int]
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0216]: l in schema 0.1 had length uint and now has length 2
  --> lineage.cue:11:5
   |
11 |                 l: [int, int]
   |                 ^
   |
   = note: schema 0.1 is declared as a minor version of 0.0, so every instance of schema 0.0 must be an instance of it (compatibility rule length-narrowed)
   = help: make the change compatible, or make this version 1.0
```
